meta.title: Heat Wave
meta.description: Summer! Sand! Sea! Swimsuits! Feel the passionate heat wave wash over you~

units.rawText: The sky is clear and blue, accompanied by a warm lovely sunlight. The laughter of Dolls fills the air like the chiming of bells, the soft white sand covered with footprints of various sizes followed by the sound of rolling waves.
units.displayText: The sky is clear and blue, accompanied by a warm lovely sunlight. The laughter of Dolls fills the air like the chiming of bells, the soft white sand covered with footprints of various sizes followed by the sound of rolling waves.

spans.text: The sky is clear and blue, accompanied by a warm lovely sunlight. The laughter of Dolls fills the air like the chiming of bells, the soft white sand covered with footprints of various sizes followed by the sound of rolling waves.

units.rawText: Thank you, Centaureissi. I would have never imagined I could get a day off like this if not for how you arranged all our tasks in such an orderly fashion...
units.displayText: Thank you, Centaureissi. I would have never imagined I could get a day off like this if not for how you arranged all our tasks in such an orderly fashion...

spans.text: Thank you, Centaureissi. I would have never imagined I could get a day off like this if not for how you arranged all our tasks in such an orderly fashion...

units.rawText: Looks like coming to the seaside for a vacation was the right choice. After working through the night for days on end, being able to feel the natural sea breeze does wonders to clear the mind and lift the spirits.
units.displayText: Looks like coming to the seaside for a vacation was the right choice. After working through the night for days on end, being able to feel the natural sea breeze does wonders to clear the mind and lift the spirits.

spans.text: Looks like coming to the seaside for a vacation was the right choice. After working through the night for days on end, being able to feel the natural sea breeze does wonders to clear the mind and lift the spirits.

units.rawText: Master, you have been working long hours recently. You should consider relaxing from time to time to ease your stress. Here, this orange juice is for you.
units.displayText: Master, you have been working long hours recently. You should consider relaxing from time to time to ease your stress. Here, this orange juice is for you.

spans.text: Master, you have been working long hours recently. You should consider relaxing from time to time to ease your stress. Here, this orange juice is for you.

units.rawText: Mmm, tastes great.
units.displayText: Mmm, tastes great.

spans.text: Mmm, tastes great.

units.rawText: There are some mint leaves in it to ease the heat. If you like it, I will provide some crispy food for you to enjoy later.
units.displayText: There are some mint leaves in it to ease the heat. If you like it, I will provide some crispy food for you to enjoy later.

spans.text: There are some mint leaves in it to ease the heat. If you like it, I will provide some crispy food for you to enjoy later.

units.rawText: Ah! There you are, Professor!
units.displayText: Ah! There you are, Professor!

spans.text: Ah! There you are, Professor!

units.rawText: Just as Centaureissi and I are conversing, I see Jiangyu in the distance, racing towards us at top speed.
units.displayText: Just as Centaureissi and I are conversing, I see Jiangyu in the distance, racing towards us at top speed.

spans.text: Just as Centaureissi and I are conversing, I see Jiangyu in the distance, racing towards us at top speed.

units.rawText: I found you at last, Professor! I've been combing the beach all day!
units.displayText: I found you at last, Professor! I've been combing the beach all day!

spans.text: I found you at last, Professor! I've been combing the beach all day!

units.rawText: Er, is there some kind of emergency...?
units.displayText: Er, is there some kind of emergency...?

spans.text: Er, is there some kind of emergency...?

units.rawText: It's a super duper emergency! You hardly get any vacation time, so you need to cherish every moment of it!
units.displayText: It's a super duper emergency! You hardly get any vacation time, so you need to cherish every moment of it!

spans.text: It's a super duper emergency! You hardly get any vacation time, so you need to cherish every moment of it!

units.rawText: Jiangyu runs up to me and grabs my arm, as though she's afraid I'll run away, and tries her best to persuade me.
units.displayText: Jiangyu runs up to me and grabs my arm, as though she's afraid I'll run away, and tries her best to persuade me.

spans.text: Jiangyu runs up to me and grabs my arm, as though she's afraid I'll run away, and tries her best to persuade me.

units.rawText: Professor, it's such a terrible waste for you to be sitting here when the weather's so good.
units.displayText: Professor, it's such a terrible waste for you to be sitting here when the weather's so good.

spans.text: Professor, it's such a terrible waste for you to be sitting here when the weather's so good.

units.rawText: Countless heroes have faded into obscurity because they just sat down and did nothing! It's an insult to the clouds!
units.displayText: Countless heroes have faded into obscurity because they just sat down and did nothing! It's an insult to the clouds!

spans.text: Countless heroes have faded into obscurity because they just sat down and did nothing! It's an insult to the clouds!

units.rawText: Those two things aren't linked, are they...
units.displayText: Those two things aren't linked, are they...

spans.text: Those two things aren't linked, are they...

units.rawText: Movement is life! Now, let's sweat together! How about a game of beach volleyball, Professor~
units.displayText: Movement is life! Now, let's sweat together! How about a game of beach volleyball, Professor~

spans.text: Movement is life! Now, let's sweat together! How about a game of beach volleyball, Professor~

units.rawText: <color=orange>Beach volleyball?</color>
units.displayText: Beach volleyball?

spans.text: Beach volleyball?

units.rawText: Before I can reply, Jiangyu is already dragging me toward the seaside.
units.displayText: Before I can reply, Jiangyu is already dragging me toward the seaside.

spans.text: Before I can reply, Jiangyu is already dragging me toward the seaside.

units.rawText: Wait, wait, wait, are we going to play with just the two of us? I don't think I can last too long by myself against a kung fu Doll like you...
units.displayText: Wait, wait, wait, are we going to play with just the two of us? I don't think I can last too long by myself against a kung fu Doll like you...

spans.text: Wait, wait, wait, are we going to play with just the two of us? I don't think I can last too long by myself against a kung fu Doll like you...

units.rawText: Haha, don't worry about that. I lured Undine in with the promise of a free lunch voucher.
units.displayText: Haha, don't worry about that. I lured Undine in with the promise of a free lunch voucher.

spans.text: Haha, don't worry about that. I lured Undine in with the promise of a free lunch voucher.

units.rawText: Jiangyu points to the girl who's running over from the distance. Whenever a part-time job calls, Undine is bound to answer.
units.displayText: Jiangyu points to the girl who's running over from the distance. Whenever a part-time job calls, Undine is bound to answer.

spans.text: Jiangyu points to the girl who's running over from the distance. Whenever a part-time job calls, Undine is bound to answer.

units.rawText: As for the other person... Want to join us, Centaureissi?
units.displayText: As for the other person... Want to join us, Centaureissi?

spans.text: As for the other person... Want to join us, Centaureissi?

units.rawText: If you need me, then I shall be there, Master.
units.displayText: If you need me, then I shall be there, Master.

spans.text: If you need me, then I shall be there, Master.

units.rawText: See, we've got a 2v2 beach volleyball team right there! Hehe, Jiangyu the rizzler settles it in three minutes~
units.displayText: See, we've got a 2v2 beach volleyball team right there! Hehe, Jiangyu the rizzler settles it in three minutes~

spans.text: See, we've got a 2v2 beach volleyball team right there! Hehe, Jiangyu the rizzler settles it in three minutes~

units.rawText: Wait, that's it?
units.displayText: Wait, that's it?

spans.text: Wait, that's it?

units.rawText: Don't worry, Master. I shall defend the team's honor.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Master. I shall defend the team's honor.

spans.text: Don't worry, Master. I shall defend the team's honor.

units.rawText: If you find things too boring, you may choose to sip your orange juice under a beach umbrella, sip your orange juice on the volleyball court, or sip your orange juice while swimming in the sea.
units.displayText: If you find things too boring, you may choose to sip your orange juice under a beach umbrella, sip your orange juice on the volleyball court, or sip your orange juice while swimming in the sea.

spans.text: If you find things too boring, you may choose to sip your orange juice under a beach umbrella, sip your orange juice on the volleyball court, or sip your orange juice while swimming in the sea.

units.rawText: Why do they all involve sipping orange juice...
units.displayText: Why do they all involve sipping orange juice...

spans.text: Why do they all involve sipping orange juice...

units.rawText: Ara—How scary. I can't believe you've been dragged over to perform physical labor while on holiday. Even medieval punishments weren't this cruel.
units.displayText: Ara—How scary. I can't believe you've been dragged over to perform physical labor while on holiday. Even medieval punishments weren't this cruel.

spans.text: Ara—How scary. I can't believe you've been dragged over to perform physical labor while on holiday. Even medieval punishments weren't this cruel.

units.rawText: A certain black-haired Doll stretches lazily as she gets up from her deck chair and slowly struts over, grabbing my hand like it's the most natural thing in the world before preparing to abscond with me.
units.displayText: A certain black-haired Doll stretches lazily as she gets up from her deck chair and slowly struts over, grabbing my hand like it's the most natural thing in the world before preparing to abscond with me.

spans.text: A certain black-haired Doll stretches lazily as she gets up from her deck chair and slowly struts over, grabbing my hand like it's the most natural thing in the world before preparing to abscond with me.

units.rawText: Nora, where are we going?
units.displayText: Nora, where are we going?

spans.text: Nora, where are we going?

units.rawText: Why, to safety, of course.
units.displayText: Why, to safety, of course.

spans.text: Why, to safety, of course.

units.rawText: Playing volleyball makes you all sweaty and sandy. Since you hardly ever get any vacation time, wouldn't you rather spend it lounging with me on the beach?
units.displayText: Playing volleyball makes you all sweaty and sandy. Since you hardly ever get any vacation time, wouldn't you rather spend it lounging with me on the beach?

spans.text: Playing volleyball makes you all sweaty and sandy. Since you hardly ever get any vacation time, wouldn't you rather spend it lounging with me on the beach?

units.rawText: Just imagine yourself basking in the sun and chatting leisurely with your friends against the quiet sounds of the wind and the waves. Or perhaps, picking up a conch and playing a one-of-a-kind summer melody...
units.displayText: Just imagine yourself basking in the sun and chatting leisurely with your friends against the quiet sounds of the wind and the waves. Or perhaps, picking up a conch and playing a one-of-a-kind summer melody...

spans.text: Just imagine yourself basking in the sun and chatting leisurely with your friends against the quiet sounds of the wind and the waves. Or perhaps, picking up a conch and playing a one-of-a-kind summer melody...

units.rawText: That sure sounds good.
units.displayText: That sure sounds good.

spans.text: That sure sounds good.

units.rawText: I know, right? That's how normal people spend their vacation. In fact, some of my fellow slobs... I mean, like-minded compatriots are slacking off... I mean, preserving their stamina with me right now.
units.displayText: I know, right? That's how normal people spend their vacation. In fact, some of my fellow slobs... I mean, like-minded compatriots are slacking off... I mean, preserving their stamina with me right now.

spans.text: I know, right? That's how
normal
people spend their vacation. In fact, some of my fellow slobs... I mean, like-minded compatriots are slacking off... I mean, preserving their stamina with me right now.

units.rawText: Come, I'll take you to meet them.
units.displayText: Come, I'll take you to meet them.

spans.text: Come, I'll take you to meet them.

units.rawText: Nora appears to have popped into existence from parts unknown, and as I follow her, several other familiar faces make their entrance one after the other.
units.displayText: Nora appears to have popped into existence from parts unknown, and as I follow her, several other familiar faces make their entrance one after the other.

spans.text: Nora appears to have popped into existence from parts unknown, and as I follow her, several other familiar faces make their entrance one after the other.

units.rawText: This is Team Stamina Preservation Member No. 1, Angela~ If you want, you can lie down beside me, and I'll tell you a story.
units.displayText: This is Team Stamina Preservation Member No. 1, Angela~ If you want, you can lie down beside me, and I'll tell you a story.

spans.text: This is Team Stamina Preservation Member No. 1, Angela~ If you want, you can lie down beside me, and I'll tell you a story.

units.rawText: Of course, if you're feeling bored, you can go with Chanzhi~
units.displayText: Of course, if you're feeling bored, you can go with Chanzhi~

spans.text: Of course, if you're feeling bored, you can go with Chanzhi~

units.rawText: Oooh, shells! Come collect shells with me! Member No. 2 Chanzhi will give you rest and no distress~
units.displayText: Oooh, shells! Come collect shells with me! Member No. 2 Chanzhi will give you rest and no distress~

spans.text: Oooh, shells! Come collect shells with me! Member No. 2 Chanzhi will give you rest and no distress~

units.rawText: The summer sun's really bright, so make sure to take care of your skin, everyone~ A perfect idol needs to keep her skin pale and clear at all times; help apply some sunscreen on us, Professor!
units.displayText: The summer sun's really bright, so make sure to take care of your skin, everyone~ A perfect idol needs to keep her skin pale and clear at all times; help apply some sunscreen on us, Professor!

spans.text: The summer sun's really bright, so make sure to take care of your skin, everyone~ A perfect idol needs to keep her skin pale and clear at all times; help apply some sunscreen on us, Professor!

units.rawText: And of course, there's me, Professor. Being fully certified with a P.H.D. (Procrastinator of the Highest Degree) in slacking off, I won't allow any work to interfere with your vacation. Any expenditure of energy exceeding the operand value of a single baozi is strictly forbidden.
units.displayText: And of course, there's me, Professor. Being fully certified with a P.H.D. (Procrastinator of the Highest Degree) in slacking off, I won't allow any work to interfere with your vacation. Any expenditure of energy exceeding the operand value of a single baozi is strictly forbidden.

spans.text: And of course, there's me, Professor. Being fully certified with a P.H.D. (Procrastinator of the Highest Degree) in slacking off, I won't allow any work to interfere with your vacation. Any expenditure of energy exceeding the operand value of a single baozi is strictly forbidden.

units.rawText: Being able to listen to stories while having sunscreen applied sounds so nice~
units.displayText: Being able to listen to stories while having sunscreen applied sounds so nice~

spans.text: Being able to listen to stories while having sunscreen applied sounds so nice~

units.rawText: Oh no, I think my arms are already sunburnt, Professor... So stay here and help us.
units.displayText: Oh no, I think my arms are already sunburnt, Professor... So stay here and help us.

spans.text: Oh no, I think my arms are already sunburnt, Professor... So stay here and help us.

units.rawText: Chanzhi gives me the most pitiful puppy eyes imaginable. Her pupils are wide and shiny, as though she's going to burst into tears at any time.
units.displayText: Chanzhi gives me the most pitiful puppy eyes imaginable. Her pupils are wide and shiny, as though she's going to burst into tears at any time.

spans.text: Chanzhi gives me the most pitiful puppy eyes imaginable. Her pupils are wide and shiny, as though she's going to burst into tears at any time.

units.rawText: Professor, we in Team Stamina Preservation are the best choice for you. Boldly ignore the harsh gazes of the world and chill with us instead.
units.displayText: Professor, we in Team Stamina Preservation are the best choice for you. Boldly ignore the harsh gazes of the world and chill with us instead.

spans.text: Professor, we in Team Stamina Preservation are the best choice for you. Boldly ignore the harsh gazes of the world and chill with us instead.

units.rawText: Al... urgh.
units.displayText: Al... urgh.

spans.text: Al... urgh.

units.rawText: Just as I'm about to agree, I feel someone's gaze burning a hole in my back. I turn around and see Jiangyu, her cheeks puffed up in annoyance, and it seems like she's about to blow her lid.
units.displayText: Just as I'm about to agree, I feel someone's gaze burning a hole in my back. I turn around and see Jiangyu, her cheeks puffed up in annoyance, and it seems like she's about to blow her lid.

spans.text: Just as I'm about to agree, I feel someone's gaze burning a hole in my back. I turn around and see Jiangyu, her cheeks puffed up in annoyance, and it seems like she's about to blow her lid.

units.rawText: There's an order to everything you know, and the Professor agreed to play beach volleyball with us first.
units.displayText: There's an order to everything you know, and the Professor agreed to play beach volleyball with us first.

spans.text: There's an order to everything you know, and the Professor agreed to play beach volleyball with us first.

units.rawText: Oh my, you DO know that taking care of your skin is a huge pain once it gets damaged by the sun, right? That means we're a higher priority, so come apply our sunscreen, Professor.
units.displayText: Oh my, you DO know that taking care of your skin is a huge pain once it gets damaged by the sun, right? That means we're a higher priority, so come apply our sunscreen, Professor.

spans.text: Oh my, you DO know that taking care of your skin is a huge pain once it gets damaged by the sun, right? That means we're a higher priority, so come apply our sunscreen, Professor.

units.rawText: Go finish up the entirety of the script you owe your editor, you foot-dragger. Zangyin's been hounding you for them for several days now.
units.displayText: Go finish up the entirety of the script you owe your editor, you foot-dragger. Zangyin's been hounding you for them for several days now.

spans.text: Go finish up the entirety of the script you owe your editor, you foot-dragger. Zangyin's been hounding you for them for several days now.

units.rawText: It's called work-life balance, my dear! Professor, you must understand, you'll end up being wrung dry if you play volleyball with an energetic lass like her.
units.displayText: It's called work-life balance, my dear! Professor, you must understand, you'll end up being wrung dry if you play volleyball with an energetic lass like her.

spans.text: It's called work-life balance, my dear! Professor, you must understand, you'll end up being wrung dry if you play volleyball with an energetic lass like her.

units.rawText: What do you mean wrung dry? It'll be fun! So which group will you be going with, Professor?
units.displayText: What do you mean wrung dry? It'll be fun! So which group will you be going with, Professor?

spans.text: What do you mean wrung dry? It'll be
fun
! So which group will you be going with, Professor?

units.rawText: Go on, choose!
units.displayText: Go on, choose!

spans.text: Go on, choose!

units.rawText: (If I'd known, I wouldn't have taken this vacation... It's actually more stressful than being at work...)
units.displayText: If I'd known, I wouldn't have taken this vacation... It's actually more stressful than being at work...

spans.text: If I'd known, I wouldn't have taken this vacation... It's actually more stressful than being at work...

units.rawText: ...I choose... I choose...
units.displayText: ...I choose... I choose...

spans.text: ...I choose... I choose...

units.rawText: There's no need to even consider, because the Professor will definitely pick us.
units.displayText: There's no need to even consider, because the Professor will definitely pick us.

spans.text: There's no need to even consider, because the Professor will definitely pick us.

units.rawText: The engine of a jet ski roars as it approaches, and with it, a huge splash of frothy white foam. Three white-haired girls emerge from it.
units.displayText: The engine of a jet ski roars as it approaches, and with it, a huge splash of frothy white foam. Three white-haired girls emerge from it.

spans.text: The engine of a jet ski roars as it approaches, and with it, a huge splash of frothy white foam. Three white-haired girls emerge from it.

units.rawText: Do you truly think the Professor is so shallow?
units.displayText: Do you truly think the Professor is so shallow?

spans.text: Do you truly think the Professor is so shallow?

units.rawText: They're definitely not the kind of person who would eagerly ditch all their responsibilities just to slack off and watch Dolls bounce around in their swimsuits.
units.displayText: They're definitely not the kind of person who would eagerly ditch all their responsibilities just to slack off and watch Dolls bounce around in their swimsuits.

spans.text: They're definitely not the kind of person who would eagerly ditch all their responsibilities just to slack off and watch Dolls bounce around in their swimsuits.

units.rawText: The Professor is here because there is something here that they can't find anywhere else.
units.displayText: The Professor is here because there is something here that they can't find anywhere else.

spans.text: The Professor is here because there is something here that they can't find anywhere else.

units.rawText: Truly, it is Master's way, to be diligent and serious at all times.
units.displayText: Truly, it is Master's way, to be diligent and serious at all times.

spans.text: Truly, it is Master's way, to be diligent and serious at all times.

units.rawText: Then the Professor came to the seaside to...
units.displayText: Then the Professor came to the seaside to...

spans.text: Then the Professor came to the seaside to...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Naturally, they're here to assess the Oasis' marine biome and operand distribution anomalies on the outskirts of the sector.</color>
units.displayText: Naturally, they're here to assess the Oasis' marine biome and operand distribution anomalies on the outskirts of the sector.

spans.text: Naturally, they're here to assess the Oasis' marine biome and operand distribution anomalies on the outskirts of the sector.

units.rawText: For the love of... Evelyn, if you have to pull something out of your ass, could you at least make it sound plausible?
units.displayText: For the love of... Evelyn, if you have to pull something out of your ass, could you at least make it sound plausible?

spans.text: For the love of... Evelyn, if you have to pull something out of your ass, could you at least make it
sound
plausible?

units.rawText: Well, it's not that far-fetched; I just wanted to...
units.displayText: Well, it's not that far-fetched; I just wanted to...

spans.text: Well, it's not that far-fetched; I just wanted to...

units.rawText: I see! Well done, Professor!
units.displayText: I see! Well done, Professor!

spans.text: I see! Well done, Professor!

units.rawText: Truly, Master's vision is grand, and their ambitions are similarly lofty. They are not things we can comprehend.
units.displayText: Truly, Master's vision is grand, and their ambitions are similarly lofty. They are not things we can comprehend.

spans.text: Truly, Master's vision is grand, and their ambitions are similarly lofty. They are not things we can comprehend.

units.rawText: To that end, we have gathered our forces and dispatched an elite team of Dolls clad in swimsuits, codenamed "Ocean Dancer", in order to better facilitate your plans.
units.displayText: To that end, we have gathered our forces and dispatched an elite team of Dolls clad in swimsuits, codenamed "Ocean Dancer", in order to better facilitate your plans.

spans.text: To that end, we have gathered our forces and dispatched an elite team of Dolls clad in swimsuits, codenamed "Ocean Dancer", in order to better facilitate your plans.

units.rawText: Team Ocean Dancer No. 1, Evelyn, in charge of finding and removing all potential violent threats. Attempted assassinations with AR-style rifles within 140 meters will not be allowed on my watch.
units.displayText: Team Ocean Dancer No. 1, Evelyn, in charge of finding and removing all potential violent threats. Attempted assassinations with AR-style rifles within 140 meters will not be allowed on my watch.

spans.text: Team Ocean Dancer No. 1, Evelyn, in charge of finding and removing all potential violent threats. Attempted assassinations with AR-style rifles within 140 meters will not be allowed on my watch.

units.rawText: I, on the other hand, will stay close to you and ensure your safety by performing immediate first aid for hazards including (but not limited to) drowning, fractures, stabbings, and the like. As for Banxsy...
units.displayText: I, on the other hand, will stay close to you and ensure your safety by performing immediate first aid for hazards including (but not limited to) drowning, fractures, stabbings, and the like. As for Banxsy...

spans.text: I, on the other hand, will stay close to you and ensure your safety by performing immediate first aid for hazards including (but not limited to) drowning, fractures, stabbings, and the like. As for Banxsy...

units.rawText: Oh, I'm just in it for the art.
units.displayText: Oh, I'm just in it for the art.

spans.text: Oh, I'm just in it for the art.

units.rawText: That's a pretty vague job description.
units.displayText: That's a pretty vague job description.

spans.text: That's a pretty vague job description.

units.rawText: That's where you're wrong, Professor. A complete team needs its elites and its everymen. My existence is to ensure the well-roundedness of "Team Ocean Dancer".
units.displayText: That's where you're wrong, Professor. A complete team needs its elites and its everymen. My existence is to ensure the well-roundedness of "Team Ocean Dancer".

spans.text: That's where you're wrong, Professor. A complete team needs its elites and its everymen. My existence is to ensure the well-roundedness of "Team Ocean Dancer".

units.rawText: Cut the crap. Professor, do not forget your initial objective. We have arranged an ideal patrol route for you along the coast, so please take your surfboard and head out with us.
units.displayText: Cut the crap. Professor, do not forget your initial objective. We have arranged an ideal patrol route for you along the coast, so please take your surfboard and head out with us.

spans.text: Cut the crap. Professor, do not forget your initial objective. We have arranged an ideal patrol route for you along the coast, so please take your surfboard and head out with us.

units.rawText: Wait, so we're surfing? Maybe that's not too...
units.displayText: Wait, so we're surfing? Maybe that's not too...

spans.text: Wait, so we're surfing? Maybe that's not too...

units.rawText: I object. Certainly, exercise is essential for the sake of your health, but surfing is too dangerous. I forbid it.
units.displayText: I object. Certainly, exercise is essential for the sake of your health, but surfing is too dangerous. I forbid it.

spans.text: I object. Certainly, exercise is essential for the sake of your health, but surfing is too dangerous. I forbid it.

units.rawText: Are you doubting my skills? The Professor will not be harmed in any way so long as I am by their side.
units.displayText: Are you doubting my skills? The Professor will not be harmed in any way so long as I am by their side.

spans.text: Are you doubting my skills? The Professor will not be harmed in any way so long as I am by their side.

units.rawText: Abandon your perfectionism, Clukay. I would rather Master be healthy and safe at all times.
units.displayText: Abandon your perfectionism, Clukay. I would rather Master be healthy and safe at all times.

spans.text: Abandon your perfectionism, Clukay. I would rather Master be healthy and safe at all times.

units.rawText: There, there, Clukay, let's not quibble about safety issues. Don't forget that we have an overwhelming advantage—check out our aesthetically pleasing swimsuits!
units.displayText: There, there, Clukay, let's not quibble about safety issues. Don't forget that we have an overwhelming advantage—check out our aesthetically pleasing swimsuits!

spans.text: There, there, Clukay, let's not quibble about safety issues. Don't forget that we have an overwhelming advantage—check out our aesthetically pleasing swimsuits!

units.rawText: How do you like them, Professor? Can you feel the appeal of art yet? Come with us and search for beauty on the waves.
units.displayText: How do you like them, Professor? Can you feel the appeal of art yet? Come with us and search for beauty on the waves.

spans.text: How do you like them, Professor? Can you feel the appeal of art yet? Come with us and search for beauty on the waves.

units.rawText: H-Hey, we have swimsuits too! In fact, it's time for us to show off our battle outfits! Undine—
units.displayText: H-Hey, we have swimsuits too! In fact, it's time for us to show off our battle outfits! Undine—

spans.text: H-Hey, we have swimsuits too! In fact, it's time for us to show off our battle outfits! Undine—
